Name: Double Size Sprite (DSS)
Author: Kreestijan
Description:
[center][size=5][b]Double Size Sprite[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Description[/b]
[line]
[color=#ff7700][size=4]This is a framework for modding, it does absolutely nothing by itself.[/size][/color]

Made this for Ton O' Fish (TOF) because I can't draw. This allows 32x32 textures for content pack assets instead of 16x16. 
I tried to use Scale UP 2 but it's a bit buggy, then I tried Scale UP Unofficial but that would not render my fishes properly in the UI of Fish Helper UI and both of those were also overkill for my needs.
 Example of minimum working setup:
{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "Load",
      "Target": "Mods/Author.Pack/Objects",
      "FromFile": "assets/objects.png"
    },
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "{{Kree.DSS/Assets}}",
      "Entries": {
        "Author.Pack_Objects": [
          {
            "Asset": "Mods/Author.Pack/Objects"
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}

That's it, then you can ship an atlas with 32x32 sprites.

[b]Main Features[/b]
[line]
[list]
[*]Allows loading of 32x32 sprites for Content Patcher packs[/*]
[/list]
